title: parabricks-fq2bam-bqsr pipeline parameters
description: Parabricks alignment and genome-wide BQSR with optional GATK-compatible static quality-score quantization

input.description: Samplesheet CSV: FASTQ entry (fastq_1 column) or alignment + table entry (alignment column).

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Built-in genome or explicit reference files; explicit parameters override genome defaults.

genome.description: Built-in genome (GATK.GRCh38), or null for a custom genome.

igenomes_base.description: Base path of built-in genome files.

bwa_index.description: Directory holding a classic BWA index of the FASTA.

known_sites.description: Comma-separated known-sites .vcf.gz files; none means BQSR is skipped.

intervals.description: Intervals restricting BQSR table building only.

no_intervals.description: Build the BQSR table genome-wide, ignoring any genome default intervals.

trim_fastq.description: Enable fastp trimming (fastp always runs for read counts and QC).

clip_r1.description: Bases removed from the 5' end of read 1.

clip_r2.description: Bases removed from the 5' end of read 2.

three_prime_clip_r1.description: Bases removed from the 3' end of read 1.

three_prime_clip_r2.description: Bases removed from the 3' end of read 2.

poly_g_trimming.description: Poly-G tail trimming by fastp, independent of --trim_fastq. auto: fastp detects two-colour instruments (NovaSeq, NextSeq) and trims there. Untrimmed poly-G tails changed about 10% of read alignments on NovaSeq data. off: fq2bam reads the original FASTQs.

markdups_se_mode.description: Single-end duplicate marking: 5prime (standard) or start-end (adapter-trimmed short fragments).

optical_duplicate_pixel_distance.description: Optical-duplicate metrics only; 2500 is usual for patterned flowcells.

fq2bam_gpus.description: GPUs for fq2bam (CPUs and memory scale with it). Default 2: on a 21x WGS sample, 2 A10Gs cut fq2bam from 48.8 to 37.6 min for about 8% more cost; set 1 to minimise cost.

fq2bam_low_memory.description: Pass --low-memory to fq2bam (one BWA stream per GPU). Off by default: on an A10G 24 GB, Parabricks' auto mode fits without it and BWA ran 27% faster on a 21x WGS sample. Turn on if a smaller GPU runs out of memory.

fq2bam_gpuwrite.description: Pass --gpuwrite to fq2bam: compress the output on a GPU. With a single GPU it shares the device with BQSR.

fq2bam_intermediate_fmt.description: Format of the duplicate-marked alignment passed from fq2bam (or markdup) to applybqsr. Not published; final outputs follow --output_fmt. BAM was 9% cheaper per 21x sample with identical results.

fq2bam_memory_gb.description: Override fq2bam's first-attempt host memory (GB); retries multiply it by the attempt number. Unset: 44 GB per GPU, at least 64. For deep samples (about 60x and up), e.g. 176 with 2 GPUs.

output_and_quantization_options.title: Output and quantization options
output_and_quantization_options.description: Final alignment format and GATK-compatible static quality-score quantization.

cram_version.description: CRAM version for CRAM output. 3.0 is readable by essentially all tools; 3.1 is smaller but older HTSlib builds (e.g. the mosdepth container) and htsjdk-based tools may not read it; mosdepth is skipped for 3.1.

quantize_quals_enabled.description: Quantize quality scores; false publishes unquantized output.

preserve_qscores_less_than.description: Qualities below this value remain unchanged.

round_down_quantized.description: Round down to a bin instead of the nearest bin in probability space.
